## Context

What repository or workflow shape were you evaluating? Please describe it without sharing private code or secrets.

## What you tried

Include the PatchProof version or commit, command or Action inputs, and any safe fixture or minimal example that helps reproduce the observation.

## Observation

What was useful, confusing, surprising, or missing?

## Suggested improvement

Describe the smallest change that would make the result more useful. Evidence, examples, and trade-offs are more helpful than a feature request without a use case.

## Disclosure check

- [ ] I removed secrets, credentials, private source, and sensitive repository paths.
- [ ] This report does not claim that PatchProof proves correctness, security, or authorship.
